meta.td_note: Market = the best anytime TD price found from a named book (mostly BetMGM, Nov 24 to 25; prediction-market prices are not used). Yardage lines are BetMGM quotes from Nov 24. Confirm the price in your own book first: a call only holds at the price shown or longer.

weather.note: Orchard Park (Highmark Stadium, outdoors), Thursday night forecast (daily night period; no hourly found): rain likely, 80 to 90% chance, low near 37F, ENE winds 15 to 25 mph with higher gusts (The Weather Channel and weather.com via Tuesday reports).
weather.effect: Rain and wind over 15 mph both apply: steer away from receiving-yard overs, especially secondary targets, toward rushing volume and unders. The sim applies the measured rain effect (weighted 85%) and the wind effect; the cold effect is left off because kickoff should sit right around 40F.

notes: Chiefs RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) is ruled out, so rookie Emmett Johnson starts; WR Tyquan Thornton is also out. Bills TE Dalton Kincaid is doubtful and WR Joshua Palmer is out, so both are left out. Chiefs TE Noah Gray and Bills TE Jackson Hawes are questionable and get no calls.
The total has dropped from 50 to 47.5 at DraftKings on the weather forecast. The yardage lines are Tuesday BetMGM quotes from before that move.

The model's total (40) sits 7.5 under DraftKings' 47.5. Almost all of that is the weather adjustment: the book has moved 2.5 points on the same forecast, so the under is a weather bet and depends on the rain and wind arriving as forecast.
